name: chat-thread
title: Chat Thread
description: Grouped chat bubbles: new messages rise in from their side, typing dots wave and Seen fades in.

perf.budget: Plain views; each new bubble runs one spring when it arrives. Only the typing dots loop, and only while shown.

a11y.reducedMotion: New messages appear without rising and the typing dots hold still.
a11y.screenReader: A polite live region; each bubble reads the sender, the text and the time.
